title: Original eBike Tour - Best of Denver - guided Bike Tour
blurb: See the top sights and hidden corners of Colorado’s capital city on a small group e-bike tour with expert, local guides. This 2 hour excursion is ideal for first-time Denver visitors who want to orient themselves to the city for future exploring. It is also great for those who have lived here and never taken a beat to get to know Denver. With an easy-to-use pedal-assist bike, you’re able to complete the city loop without breaking a sweat. With the best eBike tour in Colorado, your tour will be fun AND safe. Highlights include Denver Union Station, RINO arts district, the capital, and cruising along the creek by Confluence Park. Colorado eBike Tours is all about enjoying the scenery, feeling the city's rhythm, and catching those small, special moments along the way. (We can accommodate children 5 and older, call ahead to book a cargo bike for your child. No infants) For groups larger than 6 we typically break into two.
